description: Spectrum analyser, eight channels, 42HP, almost all display

inputs.text: One of the eight signals whose spectrum is drawn; a polyphonic cable has its channels summed and the sum analysed

notes: clicking the display freezes it, so drag near the left edge to move the module
this is the one Bogaudio module with no Panel menu item, so it keeps the light artwork whatever the rest of the plugin is set to
menu: Frequency plot — plots the frequency axis Logarithmic or Linear
Frequency range — shows part of the spectrum rather than all of it: Lower 10%, Lower 25%, Lower 50%, Lower 75%, Full, Upper 75%, Upper 50% or Upper 25%
Amplitude plot — sets the vertical scale: Decibels to -60dB, Decibels To -120dB, or Linear percentage, where 100% is 0dB
Smoothing — averages the plot over None, 10ms, 50ms, 100ms, 250ms or 500ms
Quality — the FFT size: Good is 1024 samples, High 2048, Ultra 4096 and Ultra+ 16384, each doubled at 96kHz and above
Window — the window function applied before the FFT: Kaiser, Hamming or None
